headline: Justify SEO spend in 3 numbers
body: A quick way to turn a ranking lift into a revenue projection.
caption:
Three numbers are enough to show a client what SEO is worth.

Swipe for the quick version, then try the free calculator.

upgrowth.io/tools/seo-roi
slides: Three numbers turn a ranking lift into a revenue projection
Monthly organic traffic. Pull it from Search Console.
Conversion rate. Use the site average if you have nothing better.
Average order value. Ask the client, they always know it.
Multiply by the expected traffic lift. That is your revenue number.
